name: Omacus
author: dmkenney
description: Incus for the Omarchy bar: containers and VMs across all your servers, live from Incus events. IPs, CPU and memory, snapshot age, storage pools, warnings and running tasks, with start, stop, snapshot, shell and console a click away.

barWidget.description: Incus containers and VMs: status, usage, snapshots, storage and actions. Left click opens the panel; middle or right click refreshes.

schema.label: Servers
schema.description: Comma-separated incus remote names to show. Empty shows every remote. Add a second widget with a different list for one bar item per server.

options.label: Only stops of watched instances, plus server problems

schema.label: Watched instances
schema.description: Comma-separated remote:instance pairs. A watched instance that is not running turns the bar icon red.

schema.label: Read-only
schema.description: Hide start, stop, snapshot, shell, console and launch.

schema.label: Warn when the newest snapshot is older than (days, 0 = never)
Warn when a storage pool is this full (%)
CPU and memory refresh while the panel is open (seconds)
